title: Stable Token-level Scheduling for Serverless LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.17689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Serverless inference is emerging as an efficient deployment model for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its ability to elastically scale resources, improve GPU utilization through resource sharing, and reduce infrastructure costs. However, existing approaches primarily optimize time to first token (TTFT) while overlooking inter-token latency (ITL), a key determinant of user experience during response generation. We observe that LLM inference comprises a computation-intensive prefill stage and a bandwidth-bound decode stage, where admitting new requests can disrupt ongoing decoding and increase latency. To address this, we propose Token Window Pacing (TWP), a closed-loop scheduling framework that leverages runtime feedback from ITL, queue depth, and workload characteristics to regulate request admission at the token level instead of the batch level. translated_title: 面向无服务器LLM推理的稳定Token级调度
translated_abstract: 无服务器推理正在成为大语言模型（LLM）的一种高效部署模型，因为它能够弹性扩展资源、通过资源共享提高GPU利用率并降低基础设施成本。然而，现有方法主要优化首个token生成时间（TTFT），而忽略了token间延迟（ITL），后者是决定响应生成过程中用户体验的关键因素。我们观察到，LLM推理包含一个计算密集型的预填充阶段和一个带宽受限的解码阶段，在此期间接纳新请求可能会中断正在进行的解码并增加延迟。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Token窗口调控，这是一种闭环调度框架，利用来自ITL、队列深度和工作负载特征的运行时反馈，在token级别而非批次级别调控请求接纳。TWP动态调整一个自调节的token窗口，并结合基于分块的预填充机制……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 针对无服务器LLM推理中忽视token间延迟的问题，提出了一种基于运行时反馈的闭环调度框架TWP，通过在token级别而非批次级别调控请求接纳，实现解码延迟的稳定。
en_tdlr: Proposes Token Window Pacing (TWP), a closed-loop scheduling framework that leverages runtime feedback from ITL, queue depth, and workload characteristics to regulate request admission at the token level, stabilizing inter-token latency in serverless LLM inference.
